title: I was young
html_source:
Similar structure to the ‘Cousin Stephen, you will never….’ paragraph. There is a triangulation between the introductory negative thought phrase in both paragraphs, the pause (‘Isle of saints’ and ‘I was young’) and some lighter phrases later on (‘o si, cierto!’ and ‘Ay, very like a whale’).

The triangulation is an effective delivery mechanism to sustain Joyce’s challenge in the stream of consciousness : maintain the apparently random flow of thoughts, break-up the self criticism so Stephen doesn’t appear a maudlin git and develop enough interest in the reader whilst Joyce skims the surface of Stephen’s experiences.

The next sentence skims his narcissistic episode in front of a mirror in Portrait of the Artist.
